description: This file is a header file (.h) defining interface functions and macros for FLASH RAM functionalities specific to the STM32F4 series microcontrollers. It includes function declarations for starting, stopping, enabling, and disabling flash interface clock and sleep mode, with conditional compilation based on specific MCU variants.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_StopFlashInterfaceClk
methods.description: Function to stop the Flash interface clock, marked with __RAM_FUNC indicating it runs from RAM.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_StartFlashInterfaceClk
methods.description: Function to start the Flash interface clock, marked with __RAM_FUNC.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_EnableFlashSleepMode
methods.description: Function to enable Flash sleep mode, marked with __RAM_FUNC.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_DisableFlashSleepMode
methods.description: Function to disable Flash sleep mode, marked with __RAM_FUNC.
